subject: pe
title: Globalisation of Sport
welcome_lead: From local games to global mega-events — how sport went worldwide.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on globalisation, commercialisation and media in sport.
final_note: Global sport sells dreams, sponsorship and soft power in equal measure.

concepts.def: Interconnection of economies, cultures and sport through trade and media.
Conversion of sport into a market commodity for profit.
Financial backing in exchange for brand exposure.
Global sporting event with major economic and political impact (Olympics, World Cup).
Influence through attraction rather than coercion (Nye).
Globalised labour market in elite sport.

walkthroughs.body_html: Satellite TV, sponsorship and player migration accelerate globalisation. EPL fans span every continent.
Olympics deliver soft power and infrastructure but often exceed budget (Montreal 1976 took 30 years to pay off).
Globalisation can erode local sports; cricket and football crowd out indigenous games in many regions.

options: Global reach and major economic/political impact
